CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERMARITALSTATUS_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus AS 
(
     SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCD.CUST_MARITAL_ST AS MaritalStatusId
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCD.CUST_MARITAL_ST AS MaritalStatusId
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,MaritalStatusId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,MaritalStatusId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CCD'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL;


-------INSERT TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
(
     CustomerId
    ,PeriodStartDate
    ,PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId
    ,CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

)
SELECT
     CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
    ,MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,NULL AS CustomerMaritalStatusNote
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerMaritalStatus_DELTA;

END
